read_documents.description: Read complete candidate documents by their original IDs.

search.description: Search the evidence corpus for relevant source units.

read.description: Read complete source units returned by search.

run_tests.description: Execute Python code and supplied assertions in an isolated read-only sandbox. Only public examples or self-generated assertions may be supplied. Hidden evaluation tests are unavailable.

finish.description: Submit the final answer as a JSON value matching the answer schema.
